title: Magic partition functions: Sign smoothing convolutions with Dirichlet invertible arithmetic functions
summary: Sign changes in sums of arithmetic functions and their inverses are a subtle topic with room to grow new results. Suppose that $S_f(x) := \sum_{n \leq x} f(n)$ is the summatory function of some arithmetic function $f$ such that $f(1) \neq 1$. There are known lower bounds on the limiting growth of $V(S_f, Y)$ -- the number of sign changes of $S_f(y)$ on the interval $y \in (0, Y]$ as $Y \rightarrow \infty$.
